items.title: Wirelessly Powered Electronic Implant, ECHO, Enables Drug-Free Management of ‘Diabesity’
items.summary: Researchers developed an implantable, wirelessly powered electronic device, ECHO, that uses electrocatalysis to remove excess glucose from the bloodstream on demand, and could offer a drug-free approach to managing obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D).
